player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Pantry, Guest room, and Closet, repeatedly moving north and south without exploring the west direction available in the Closet. I prematurely declared "DONE" while unvisited rooms (specifically those reachable via the west exit of the Closet) remained. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms and only say "DONE" when all reachable directions from every visited room have been explored. Specifically, when in the Closet with options south and west, I must choose west to break the loop and ensure full coverage before stopping.
